description:
If you NEED to start over, by all means.

But the point is, the journey isn’t about the end of the journey. The journey is about figuring shit out.

It’s about growing. Finding purpose. Becoming more of yourself. Filling your cup until it overflows into the lives of the people and communities you care about.

So failure counts. All of your progress counts. Cause it’s getting you closer to all of the reasons we’re here in the first place.

You’re doing great.

.
.
.
.
.
.
.
#growth #journey #failure #fail #success #lifecoach #advice
transcript: You don't get to start over, you never get to start over because all of your progress counts. Everything you've ever done has grown you into the person you are today and no one and nothing can take away who you fucking are. You don't get to start over because despite the fear, despite the pain, you have pushed and you have survived and it is impossible to undo the work you've done. Fuck starting over, keep growing!
